stop: Stop when every env group has unit sidecars with matching sha256 (exploratory train/cal/test/E-H1..4 and confirmatory conf-ID/conf-E-H1..4), or at the owner cap.
_doc: Role env (docs/board/env.md). Task cfcap/env/task.py:TASK via --task-spec: HM3D-calibrated procedural buildings (cfcap.env.buildings), missions -> per-segment requirements on the 10 legs, T1 truth via cfcap.gen.simrun.label_conditions under each (mu factor, payload) condition. One row per (mission, candidate, segment). Units are pure functions of (family, mission index); a lost box just requeues. Confirmatory groups use --spare-shard0: shard 0 (the canary, excluded by the scorer) runs one exploratory timing unit only; do not read conf labels before 2026-11-26 01:45Z.

groups.name: env-train
groups.pilot: local 4070 Ti S, cfcap.env (heavy.sh --gpu), python -m cfcap.runner env_missions --task-spec cfcap.env.task:TASK -> $CFCAP_OUT/env/pilot2 (test/cal 150-mission units 9.9-13.5 s, E-H2 22-31 s) and pilot1 (test/E-H1/E-H3/E-H4 100-mission units 5-10 s); unit_s = 500-mission unit scaled x1.3 for a 3090
groups.purpose: Exploratory train missions in HM3D-calibrated buildings with closed-loop T1 truth per mission segment, for learning and tuning mission-level certified plans.
